test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

The famous author / clearly mentioned / all the names of his friends / in the acknolledgments of the book.

options.text: in the acknolledgments of the book.
all the names of his friends

solution:
The correct answer is '1'' i.e. in the acknolledgments of the book has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The spelling of 'acknolledgments' in the given segment is incorrect.
 
• The correct spelling should be **'acknowledgments'**, indicating the part of the book where the author thanks those who have helped him or her.
 
• Spelling errors can change the meaning of a sentence or make it difficult to understand.
 
• Therefore, correcting spelling errors is crucial for clear communication and to maintain the professionalism of the text.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *The famous author clearly mentioned all the names of his friends in the acknowledgments of the book*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'The famous author'** introduces the subject of the sentence without any grammatical errors.
 
• **'clearly mentioned'** correctly uses the past tense to describe the author's action of naming his friends.
 
• **'all the names of his friends'** accurately conveys the content of the acknowledgments without any spelling or grammatical errors.
